title: Eternize
summary: ETER'NIZE, verb transitive [Low Latin oeterno.] 1. To make endless. 2. To continue the existence or duration of indefinitely; to perpetuate; as, to eternize woe. So we say, to eternize fame or glory.

inlines.v: ETER'NIZE, verb transitive [Low Latin oeterno.] 1. To make endless. 2. To continue the existence or duration of indefinitely; to perpetuate; as, to eternize woe. So we say, to eternize fame or glory. 3. To make forever famous; to immortalize; as, to eternize a name; to eternize exploits.
